content.text: No audit right exists anywhere in the document ("examine", "books", "review" return nothing; "premises" appears only in the recital boilerplate). Re-submitting the compliant finding with the rationale tightened to address the deterministic frequency check.

input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: Compliant; no redline. The Agreement grants RadialSpark no audit, inspection or verification right over Clear Capital. Section 3(b) (p0014) — the location flagged by the planner — is a one-way invoicing mechanic: the Contractor must supply supporting detail, dates, hours and expense receipts with its invoices, and it confers no right to examine our records, usage, systems or premises. The only access-related provision, § 1 (p0007), runs in our favour, requiring Contractor personnel to comply with our facility rules and our policies concerning access to and security of Company computer systems. Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verif", "examine", "books", "review" and "records" return no examination right binding us ("records" appears only in the IP-ownership and confidentiality definitions; "premises" only in the recital boilerplate). The complete absence of any audit right is strictly better for us than the preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor's cost, no system access), so there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to constrain and nothing to edit; flagging a deviation would over-flag against our own interest. The failed deterministic check "audit frequency limited" is expected noise: a frequency cap cannot be located because there is no audit right to cap, not because audits are unlimited. This is treated as compliant rather than "missing" because the rule is a protective cap on a counterparty right, so its absence creates no gap needing new language. Residual watch item: if a Statement of Work later introduces a records-examination or usage-verification right, we should apply the preferred limits at that point.
